registration_note: Pair membership, evidence modes, and the independent confirmation seed range were fixed before model selection. Screening seed counts and the shared target-only bookkeeping were finalized after runtime smoke testing, so this file is not described as a fully preregistered protocol.
objective: Test whether source-schema evidence adds value beyond target-only LLM skills across new transfer directions and a previously unreported target dataset.

llm_generation.generation_rule: Generate one source-schema skill record per pair and one shared target-only record per unique target, so different sources do not receive different target-only samples.

runtime_smoke_test.purpose: Validate the server runtime and output contract only. These seeds are excluded from skill, strategy, and claim selection.

confirmation_protocol.rule: Freeze the development-selected skill family before confirmation. Confirmation calibration may choose only its execution strategy and target-only anchor.

primary_comparisons: source_schema_only router versus strongest target-only optimizer
target_only LLM router versus strongest target-only optimizer
source_schema_only router versus target_only LLM router

pairs.novelty: Source-schema ablation was not part of the frozen 2026-07-22 headline result.
Reverse molecular transfer direction with an explicit public role map.
Matbench dielectric is a new held-out target in the frozen multidomain report.
Tests whether a different materials source changes the strategy selected for the same new target.
New reverse reaction-transfer direction; previous Buchwald-Hartwig evidence used Suzuki as source.

reporting_rule: Report all five pairs and both evidence modes, including fallback, null, and negative outcomes. Do not use confirmation outcomes to revise prompts, skills, router thresholds, or pair membership.
